description: Genie React gives AI coding agents React DevTools access to a running React or React Native app through the genie-react CLI. It reports which components re-rendered and why, effect runs and loops, render performance before and after a change, TanStack Query and Router state, Redux actions, Suspense, hydration and error boundaries. Its verify command checks render-count, render-cause, effect and error-boundary claims to confirm a fix.
rules: Pass the same --session name to every Genie command as the agent-browser or agent-device session that drives the app, and read results only after `npx genie-react status --session <name>` reports ready: true.

Genie records renders and effects only inside a window: call react_clear_renders before the interaction, perform it once, then call react_quiesce before reading react_render_causes or react_get_renders.

To prove a fix, run `npx genie-react verify begin` with --claim flags before driving the interaction and `npx genie-react verify end <id>` after it. The exit code is the verdict: 0 pass, 1 fail, 4 refused, 5 inconclusive.
Include a `render <Component> min 1` claim for a component the interaction must change, so an interaction that missed the app fails instead of passing.
On a refused verdict, run the `$` command it prints and repeat the interaction. Report a fix only on a pass.
A render cause graded exact is proof, inferred is a lead, and unknown is still open.
